title: Generate Reaction Events for the RRMS DES Model — gen_react_events
text: event reaction defined using add_reactevt. reaction events update utilities_disease costs_disease event time using EDSS-specific utility cost. following reaction events defined: initialise Sets current_treatment current_treatment_code arm simulated. Adjusts death event time relative model entry caps time_horizon. Schedules first annual_treatment event. age Updates age refreshes utilities_disease costs_disease current EDSS state. annual_treatment Increments years_on_treatment 1 updates treatment-line time counter (t_2ndline, t_3rdline, t_4thline) RRMS patients treatment. Schedules next annual_treatment event one year ahead edss_value <= 6. Applies instantaneous treatment acquisition, administration, monitoring costs (costs_treatment) conditional treatment year SPMS status,costs scaled treatment load factor. relapse Increments n_relapse 1. Applies instantaneous relapse disutilities relapse costs. Schedules next relapse using exponential draw exponential distribution using baseline log-rate HARRMS patients modified treatment-specific ARR rate ratio NMA. edss_increase Increments edss_value 1, capped (EDSS 9). Increments n_edssinc_evts 1. Sets treatment_stop <- 1 edss_value > 6 treatment already stopped — triggers cessation treatment cost accrual applies placebo hazard ratios future events. Schedules next edss_increase event drawn exponential distribution using baseline log-rate HARRMS patients modified treatment-specific CDP6 hazard ratio NMA. edss_decrease Decrements edss_value 1, floored (EDSS 0). Increments n_edssdec_evts 1. Checks sets treatment_stop edss_increase. Schedules next edss_decrease event drawn exponential distribution patients. progression Sets spms_flag <- 1, converting patient RRMS SPMS. Progression can occur ; new progression event scheduled. Immediately updates utilities_disease costs_disease SPMS values current EDSS state. applies patients edss_value > 4. death Sets curtime <- Inf, ending patient's simulation. Updates utilities_disease costs_disease final EDSS state. new events scheduled. Death can occur . serious_adverse_event Increments n_sae_evts 1. Applies SAE disutility SAE costs. Schedules next SAE' Drawn exponential distribution using baseline SAE rate modified treatment-specific SAE hazard ratio NMA . treatment_switch Increments treatment_line 1 n_switch 1. Marks current treatment used v_prior_treatment_indices. Resets years_on_treatment 0. New treatment selection logic: First switch (n_switch == 1): samples available higher-line treatments (excluding current prior treatments), weighted proportion patients 3rd line registry. Second later switch (n_switch >= 2): samples uniformly remaining available treatments. discontinuation rate updated reflect protocol assumption patients switch twice (starting 2nd line, reaching 4th line final option). Schedules next treatment_switch event drawn exponential distribution using baseline discontinuation hazard modified treatment-specific discontinuation hazard ratios.
